newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end down in correction.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end down in correction.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended down as the market corrected on Wednesday after sharp recent rises despite strong speculative buying in some secondaries, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed down 2.30 points, or 0.34 percent, at 670.59 points after hitting a low of 667.81 points.
Decliners led advancers by 70 to 40, with 71 counters unchanged. Total turn-over was estimated at about 473.2 billion rupiah, compared with 660 billion rupiah on Tuesday.
Blue chip counters such as telecommunications firm Indosat and tobacco company Gudang Garam were among the targets of foreign profit-takers, brokers said.

"This (the fall in the index) is purely a technical correction. Look at the volume, when the index is going down the volume is smaller than when it was moving up," one broker with a local firm said. He said he believed that indicated market sentiment was firm but there was a lack of driving factors.
An analyst at a local securities firm predicted that the index would be able to maintain a level of 660-670 points on Thursday despite possible further profit-taking.
Property firm Bakrieland was the most active stock, with some 52.6 million shares traded as it fell 125 rupiah to 1,775 rupiah on local profit-taking, brokers said.

Sentiment on tourism firm Bayu Buana remained firm despite a one-hour suspension in early Tuesday trading, brokers said. Bayu rose 250 rupiah, or about 20 percent, to close at 1,475 rupiah in active trading on renewed market talk of a possible take-over, brokers said.
Shipping firm Berlian Laju Tanker also made strong gains, rising 175 rupiah to 2,575 rupiah on a volume of 10 million shares on positive fundamentals.
Pulp and paper maker Indah Kiat was down on selling pressure which brokers said was linked to a recent announcement of a rights issue.
Last week, Indah Kiat announced a 45-for-50 rights issue at 1,000 rupiah, attached with 14 warrants.
One foreign analyst firm said the market felt the issue was expensive.
Brokers and analysts also said they heard market talk that the firm was likely to issue one trillion rupiah in bonds.
Indah Kiat officials were not available for comment.
